Rita H: heads-up: publishflow blocked on a tiny regen diff from the generated types in packages/sdk. looks like ordering-only, but CI greedily suggested a minor bump.

Omar T: can you paste the diff? ordering-only or shape change?

Rita H: small example: 
```diff
- export type Status = "ready" | "pending";
+ export type Status = "pending" | "ready";
```
No logical change, just union ordering.

Build Bot: regen-check failed on runner ubuntu-20.04-5; diff in packages/sdk/src/types/status.ts; publishguard: blocked

Nikhil S: we should not treat order-only union/property reorders as semver-minor. two possible fixes: (A) teach changelog-gen to run a semantic AST compare that ignores ordering, or (B) make the generator emit a stable canonical sort. Prefer both long-term.

Rita H: short-term mitigation: open PR to whitelist order-only diffs for publishguard (manual review still required). medium-term: stable-sort in the codegen output.

Omar T: another wrinkle: sample-app snapshot tests assert the whole generated file as text. they failed because of ordering. test snapshots should compare parsed structures not raw text.

Nikhil S: agreed. plan: 1) change sample-app snapshot assertions to parse and compare by keys/sets (PR#1), 2) add stable-sort in typegen postprocess + unit test (PR#2), 3) update changelog-gen to treat order-only AST diffs as patch (follow-up ticket).

Rita H: I started PR#1 and PR#2 drafts. PR#1 fixes snapshots; PR#2 adds stable-sort and a small CI check. will push in ~45m.

Build Bot: publishflow guard: still blocked -> awaiting human action. ticket created: DX-988 (typegen-ordering).

release-oncall: manual override allowed if PR#1 merged and a follow-up issue for changelog behavior created. please ping when ready.

Omar T: thanks. once PR#1 merges we can unblock safely. Nikhil, can you create the changelog-gen ticket so we don't lose track?

Nikhil S: will do. creating DX-989 now and linking to DX-988. will also add a short devex doc note about what constitutes an autogenerated-type semver change. :memo:
